items.name: Franconia Mini Open A 2023
items.information:
Franconia Mini Open A 2023 is open to every citizen from every nation. 

Franconia Mini Open A 2023 is a one-day competition and series competition to Franconia Mini Open B 2023, which will be held one day later. Please note that you can only compete in one of the two competitions. If you register for both competitions, only the first registration will be valid and we will immediately delete the second (later) registration.

Franconia Mini Open A 2023 ist eine Ein-Tages-Competition und Partner-Competition von Franconia Mini Open B 2023, die einen Tag später stattfinden wird. Bitte beachte, dass du nur an einem der beiden Wettbewerbe teilnehmen kannst. Wenn du dich für beide Wettbewerbe anmeldest, so zählt nur die erste Anmeldung und wir werden die zweite (spätere) Anmeldung unverzüglich löschen.

items.name: Mt. Prospect Mini Marathon 2023

venue.name: Mt. Prospect Public Library
venue.address: 10 S. Emerson St, Mount Prospect, IL 60056, USA

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [WCA Competition Tutorial] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf). There is a one guest limit for this competition due to the size of the room. This also means that no outside spectators will be allowed.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473/) to get notified when future competitions in the area get announced and to socialize with other speedcubers!

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

items.name: Empire State Winter Warmup 2023
items.information:
This is a series competition with [Empire State Winter Whirl 2023](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateWinterWhirl2023). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Empire State Winter Whirl 2023, your registration for this competition will be rejected.

All competitors must read the COVID Safety tab before registering, as proof of full vaccination or a negative test will be required. **Competitors may bring at most one guest.**
